description:
𝐌𝐞𝐞𝐭 𝐙𝐞𝐫𝐨-𝐃𝐚𝐲

Five people who look like ex-convicts on a group outing from Polangui, but actually survived on instant coffee and pure audacity. Our logo is a Friends parody, but unlike that show, our Wi-Fi works and nobody is on a break. Nobody is okay either, but that’s a different ticket.

- “𝑾𝒆 𝒅𝒐𝒏’𝒕 𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒄𝒉 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒔𝒕𝒂𝒓𝒔. 𝑾𝒆 𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒄𝒉 𝒇𝒐𝒓 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒄𝒐𝒇𝒇𝒆𝒆 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒔𝒏𝒂𝒄𝒌𝒔, 𝒂𝒏𝒅 𝒔𝒐𝒎𝒆𝒕𝒉𝒊𝒏𝒈 𝒊𝒏 𝒕𝒉𝒆 𝒅𝒂𝒓𝒌 𝒓𝒆𝒂𝒄𝒉𝒆𝒔 𝒃𝒂𝒄𝒌.”
